capabilities: Display a grid dashboard of widgets that opens on startup
Run a pomodoro focus timer with session history and daily averages
Manage a todo board with priority levels
Expand concepts and generate MCQ, cloze, and true-false questions with AI
Surface news-tagged or archived notes in a daily review feed
disambiguation: Not a table editor or data tool despite the name; it is a dashboard of focus, task, and study widgets.
extras: Not yet accepted into the Community Plugins store; install via BRAT, a GitHub Release, or by building from source. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dashboard that combines focus timing, task tracking, AI-assisted study, and daily review in a single native view.

relations.evidence: Built as a single custom ItemView (no Dataview dependency)

requires.name: AI provider key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, and others)
local Cloakfetch Python service for article fetching and AI proxy fallback

summary: Dashboard view with a pomodoro timer, todo board, AI-based learning and active-recall widgets, end-of-day review, and a news feed stored in IndexedDB.
